description: A mixer insert: one signal added into another at a set level, with a scaled copy of the result on a second output

params.text: Sets how much of the ON input is added to the IN signal; the centre of its travel adds nothing and the two ends add plus and minus one and a half times
Sets the level of the AS output against the OUT signal; the centre of its travel gives silence and the two ends give plus and minus one and a half times

inputs.text: The signal passed straight through to OUT
The signal added to OUT at the level the ON knob sets

outputs.text: The OUT signal scaled by the AS knob; with a polyphonic cable each channel is also multiplied by every channel below it, so only the first channel carries the level the knob sets
The IN signal with the ON input added to it at the level the ON knob sets

notes: both knobs are centre zero: the middle of the travel passes nothing and the two halves differ in sign

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
